2. The complete resource library

All four units, lesson resources, five activity packs, Python examples, SQL databases, revision, teacher planning and printable downloads. Includes public explained answers and teacher copies.

Download complete library · ZIP · 10.6 MB

  1. Download and extract the ZIP fully, keeping its folders together.
  2. Open index.html in your browser. Follow the local menus as usual.
  3. Open PDFs separately to print; use the chapter print controls for student or answer copies.

Reading, diagrams, local navigation and bundled downloads work without internet. External websites and official SCSA documents linked online require a connection. Python, Pygame and SQL execution need their own installed tools; the ZIP does not install them. Browser settings may limit saved progress when opening local files. The single-file readers are the simplest reading fallback.

Reading and access options

  • Use your browser zoom and text size settings. At narrow widths, tables, code and large diagrams scroll within their own region.
  • Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between controls, Enter to follow links and Space or Enter to open answer sections. A visible focus outline shows your position.
  • Diagram text descriptions and full-size links accompany textbook figures. Open the full-size image for dense relationship labels.
  • Chapter print buttons offer student copies or explained answers. Your browser can save a PDF; preview the page range before printing.

For a school-managed device that blocks local scripts, use the self-contained readers for reading and the PDFs for practice. Keep the complete folder for a device where local browsing is permitted.
